provenance.description: Actual binding failure execution effects, modes, typed causes and conditional contexts. Supporting echo/printf writer-vs-closed-reader SIGPIPE observations remain in prefix-pipeline-error-class-oracle.json but are not deterministic reference cases; this fixture uses a no-output lastpipe producer instead.

cases.stdin: readonly x; x=7 /bin/true | cat; printf "statuses:<%s>\n" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
readonly x; x=7 : | cat; printf "statuses:<%s>\n" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
readonly x; x=7 eval : | cat; printf "statuses:<%s>\n" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
readonly BASHPID; BASHPID=7 /bin/true | cat; printf "statuses:<%s>\n" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
readonly BASHPID; BASHPID=7 : | cat; printf "statuses:<%s>\n" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
readonly BASHPID; BASHPID=7 eval : | cat; printf "statuses:<%s>\n" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
readonly x; false; x=7 /bin/true | cat; printf "statuses:<%s>\n" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
readonly x; false; x=7 : | cat; printf "statuses:<%s>\n" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
readonly x; x=7 /bin/sh -c 'printf ran > marker; exit 7'; echo status:$?; [ ! -e marker ] || cat marker
readonly x; x=7 eval 'printf ran > marker; false'; echo status:$?; [ ! -e marker ] || cat marker
set -e; readonly x; x=7 /bin/sh -c 'printf ran > marker; exit 7'; echo status:$?; [ ! -e marker ] || cat marker
set -e; readonly x; x=7 eval 'printf ran > marker; false'; echo status:$?; [ ! -e marker ] || cat marker
set -o posix; readonly x; x=7 /bin/sh -c 'printf ran > marker; exit 7'; echo status:$?; [ ! -e marker ] || cat marker
set -o posix; readonly x; x=7 eval 'printf ran > marker; false'; echo status:$?; [ ! -e marker ] || cat marker
set -e; readonly x; if x=7 eval 'echo ran'; then echo then; else echo else; fi; echo after
set -e; readonly x; x=7 eval 'echo ran' || echo caught; echo after
set -o posix; readonly x; x=7 : | cat; echo status:${PIPESTATUS[*]}
trap 'echo ERR' ERR; readonly x; x=7 :; echo status:$?
readonly x; x=bad y=good eval 'echo y:$y'; echo status:$?
readonly x; x=7 /bin/sh -c 'echo ran; exit 7' | cat; echo status:${PIPESTATUS[*]}
set -e; f() { readonly x; x=7 eval 'echo ran'; echo inafter; }; f || echo caught; echo after
set -e; declare -n a=b; declare -n b=a; if a=7 eval 'echo ran'; then echo then; fi; echo after
set -e; a=(one); if a[-3]=x eval 'echo ran'; then echo then; fi; echo after
set -o posix; declare -n a=b; declare -n b=a; a=7 eval 'echo ran'; echo after
set -o posix; a=(one); a[-3]=x eval 'echo ran'; echo after
readonly x; x=7 | cat; echo status:${PIPESTATUS[*]}
readonly x; (x=7 :); echo status:$?
readonly x; x=7 :; echo status:$?
declare -n a=b; declare -n b=a; a=7 : | cat; echo status:${PIPESTATUS[*]}
declare -i n=1; n+='1/0' : | cat; echo status:${PIPESTATUS[*]}
a=(one); a[-3]=x : | cat; echo status:${PIPESTATUS[*]}
readonly x; shopt -s lastpipe; /bin/true | x=7 :; echo status:${PIPESTATUS[*]}
